testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu presentation choices without changing settings: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1953:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect marking-menu presentation choices without changing settings ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And Marking Menu Style is "Show Icon and Text" ✔ And Overflow Menu is "Full Menu" ✔ When the user opens the Marking Menu Style selector ✔ Then the available styles include "Show Icon and Text", "Show Icon Only" and "Show Text Only" ✔ And "Show Icon and Text" remains selected ✔ When the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option ✔ And the user opens the Overflow Menu selector ✔ Then the available overflow choices include "Full Menu", "Radial Menu Only" and "Short Menu" ✔ And "Full Menu" remains selected ✔ When the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option ✔ Then no customization change is pending
